era: 2019 TechCrunch (the 2018 redesign, unchanged through 2019 for every visitor; no sign-in variant): white page, fixed left rail with the green TC mark, a green-outlined Login button, 22px light grey section links (Startups, Apps, Gadgets, Videos, Audio, Extra Crunch, Newsletters, Events, Advertise, Crunchbase, More), a 'Search' label and small green topic links; homepage hero = 36px extra-bold headline with author and image below, a 227px column of 18px extra-bold headlines with authors and #ddd rules, an events widget in the right rail, then 'The Latest' river (22px titles, grey excerpt, image right). Articles: 36px extra-bold title, author / time byline, 18px Helvetica body, share bar (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Email, Copy link).

sources.shows: homepage (found through Google Images 'techcrunch website homepage screenshot', 2019 date filter): left rail with TC mark, Login, Startups…More, Search, green topic links; 36px hero headline, mini headlines with authors, Extra Crunch promo
